# URLs
https?://\S+

# Email addresses
[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}

# Git commit SHA
\b[0-9a-f]{40}\b

# Markdown anchors
\]\(#[-a-zA-Z0-9_]+\)

# Markdown links
\]\(https?://[^)]+\)

# Inline code
`[^`]+`

# Code blocks
^```

# GitHub repository references
github\.com/[-\w]+/[-\w]+

# GitHub Actions uses
\buses:\s+[-\w.]+/[-\w./]+@[-\w.]+\b

# Version numbers
\bv?\d+\.\d+(\.\d+)?\b

# Hex colors
#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}\b

# UUIDs
\b[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12}\b
